newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Hi-Bred buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Hi-Bred buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Wednesday she reiterated a buy rating on seed company Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc with a target price of $75 a sahre.
-- Wittenburg said Pioneer indicated in a presentation that it is comfortable that fiscal 1997 earnings will be between $2.70 and $3.10 a share, up from $2.68 a year ago.
-- Pioneer is expected to gain market share in fiscal 1997 in U.S. seed corn, probably more than making up for the one percentage point loss in market share in fiscal 1996, the analyst said.

-- The company indicated that analyst estimates of a price increase of six to eight percent for seed corn were within reason, Wittenburg said. "We believe Pioneer will price ahead of cost increases to net a margin gain." Pricing will be announced around November 1.
-- Cost of goods sold in fiscal 1997 for seed corn is expected to range between $28 and $30 per bag, compared with a little less than $26 in 1996 and less than $24 in 1995.
-- Wittenburg said Pioneer is expected to have 2.4 million bags of genetically enhanced Roundup Ready soybeans and 450,000 bags of genetically enhanced Bt corn available.

-- Pioneer said it expects 25 percent growth in seed corn volume in the United States over the next 10 years to help meet a 25 percent worldwide increase in meat demand, according to Wittenburg. Worldwide, the company expects seed demand to increase only 13 percent, but expects higher growth in the United States due to greater productivity in this country.
